data.case_title: Health insurance contribution increase – Musterquell Krankenkasse
data.title: Contribution increase notice from Musterquell Krankenkasse
data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that, from 1 January 2027, her monthly contributions for statutory health and long-term care insurance (as a voluntarily insured member) will rise to €318.46, due to a new supplementary contribution rate and her income shown in her 2025 tax assessment.
data.explanation: Your Krankenkasse is raising your monthly voluntary health/long-term care insurance contribution to €318.46 starting 1 January 2027. The letter includes an objection (Widerspruch) notice: you may decide whether to challenge this decision, and the app will show the deadline for doing so based on when the letter is deemed delivered. If you take no action, the new amount becomes binding and will continue to be debited on the 15th of the following month as before. If you believe the calculation is wrong, consider getting advice before the deadline shown.
data.tax_note: Contributions to statutory health and long-term care insurance are generally deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in the annual tax return.
